jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Representative (English + East EU language)
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. You work hand in hand with the External Sales Representative and help strengthen customer relationships, drive sales growth, and promote the use of our digital tools. 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Open new customer accounts (approx. 30%) and grow business with existing customers (approx. 70%) 

• Prepare accurate offers and price calculations 

• Enter and follow up on orders 

• Actively manage your accounts via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digital migration 

• Maintain and update customer data in the internal system 

• Understand customer needs, market context, product applications, and competitors 

• Be the main point of contact for customer inquiries, complaints, and support 

• Identify and close commercial opportunities 

• Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales 

• Contribute to the team with flexibility and a hands-on attitude 
 

• You have a technical and/or commercial background 

• You have at least 4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably with technical products 

• You are fluent in English (spoken and written) – mandatory 

• Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong asset 

• French and/or Arabic is an asset 

• Strong skills in Excel and general IT tools 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• You are proactive, persuasive, structured, and a true team player 

• Able to multitask and work under pressure in a small but ambitious team

ICTS is the trusted partner for trailer rental, fleet maintenance and repairs, field services, and 24/7 roadside assistance. The company provides customers with a complete, worry-free solution for maintenance, servicing, breakdown support, and other on-road services. To strengthen its team, ICTS is looking for an Operations Manager.
 

Ready to take on responsibility within a growing international company? Then you might be the one that we are looking for!
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 
 

• Leading, coaching and supporting the operational teams in Belgium, the Netherlands and Poland. 

• Organising and overseeing daily operations and rental planning in close cooperation with the workshops. 

• Monitoring the availability and quality of the trailer fleet, including correct inspections at handover and return. 

• Ensuring professional customer service, accurate administration and the proper follow-up of damage cases. 

• Monitoring operational KPI’s, resolving bottlenecks and implementing improvements where needed. 

• Promoting effective cooperation between operations, workshops and administration. 

PROFILE
 
 

• Proven experience in a supervisory or management role within an operational environment, preferably in transport, logistics or a technical sector. 

• A higher education qualification or an equivalent level gained through experience, combined with strong planning and organisational skills. 

• Clear communication, a coaching approach and the confidence to make decisions. 

• A customer-focused, proactive and solution-oriented mindset, even under pressure. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office and the ability to learn new software quickly. 

• Excellent command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Following comprehensive in-house training, you will work independently with a variety of sheet metal processing machines. You will manufacture and process metal components according to technical drawings and ensure a high-quality finish for every part.

Your responsibilities include:

• Operating and setting up various sheet metal processing machines.

• Performing cutting and bending operations based on technical drawings.

• Calculating flat patterns and preparing production parts.

• Processing metal components through bending, cutting, punching, tapping, and grinding.

• Performing semi-automatic welding when required.

• Inspecting finished products for quality and dimensional accuracy.

• Ensuring compliance with safety and quality procedures.

• You hold an A2 degree in Mechanics or have equivalent experience.

• You have experience with a guillotine shear, press brake, corner notching machine, and punching machine.

• You can read and accurately interpret technical drawings.

• You possess strong spatial awareness and technical insight.

• You work accurately, independently, and with a strong focus on quality.

• You follow safety and quality procedures diligently.

• Good knowledge of Dutch or English is sufficient.

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

We are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.
Your responsibilities
As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization
• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes
• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions
• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings
• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines
• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment
In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential
• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems
• Fluent communication skills in English
• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues
• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus
You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

For a company in Diegem we are looking for a GIS Analyst. The company provides a service platform for collecting road toll charges in European countries using a smart GPS based tolling system. 

You will support the Map and Tariff team which is responsible for the digital map that is used in the final product.

You support the team in correct and accurate representation of geo information in the databases. 

This includes below activities: 

 
• Map Modelling: utilizing map editing tools such as ArcGIS Pro and QGIS to make changes to the digital map. 
This might involve adding new features, modifying existing ones, or deleting outdated or incorrect information. 
 
• Assisting the team in various GIS and data analyses. 
 
• Creating routine reports using the report creating tools 
 
• Documentation

 

 
• You have a bachelor's or master's degree in one of the following fields: Geography, Bio-engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Electromechanical Engineering 
 
• You have a passion for maps and IT 
 
• Ideally you are experienced in using a GIS Editing tool: ArcMap, ArcGIS Pro (ESRI) or QGIS 
 
• SQL, object-oriented programming and FME knowledge are a plus 
 
• You are fluent in English

Based on its vision and strategy, our client aims to be a leading global supplier, meeting customer needs in transport and logistics services, focused on extensive growth and one of the most profitable companies in our industry. Their employees play the leading role in this. They strive to attract, motivate and retain talented people by offering responsibility, empowerment and growth opportunities. They nurture sound business sense and work together as a global family to grow the business.

Jobomschrijving

For the Ghent site, we are looking for reach truck drivers (with and without experience) who can work dayshifts.

• You will correctly handle goods for the customer in the warehouse. Accuracy and attention to detail are very important.
• You will be responsible for loading/unloading in the warehouse using a reach truck.
• You will use a scanning system to pick the correct goods.
• You will also use a manual transpallet or an electric transpallet to move the picked goods.
• You will work independently according to imposed procedures.
 

• Attestation reach truck
• Very good English knowledge and basic NL OR very good NL.
• You want a long-term commitment.
• You are flexible in terms of tasks, occasionally supporting order picking is also necessary!
• Working dayshifts, starting between 6h and 10h   also flexible to work on Saturdays occasionally
• Eye for detail to accurately record numerical codes and perform quality checks
• Logistical insight
• Good physical condition to manually take the goods from the racks and put them on the transpallet
• Own transport or via Maxmobiel from Dampoort Station

For our client in Tielt, specialized in recycling foam materiales is looking for an extra co-worker.

Tasks:

- setting up and starting the machine

- quality control

- discharge and supply of raw materials with forklift truck

- keeping work area tidy

- You have experience driving a forklift

- You have no physical complaints

- You speak, understand and read English well

- Working in 2 shifts.

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

jobs.occupation: CE Dump Truck Driver – Reliable Shuttle Between Sint-Katelijne-Waver & Hemiksem
jobs.description:
As a CE Dump Truck Driver (m/f/x), you are responsible for daily shuttle transport between Sint-Katelijne-Waver and Hemiksem. You operate a tipper truck to ensure goods are loaded, transported, and unloaded safely and correctly. Safety, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility are key in this role.

Your average workday begins with a vehicle inspection. You load materials, depart on time to the next location, and ensure smooth delivery. In addition to transporting goods, you handle transport documents correctly and comply with driving and rest time regulations. You keep your truck clean and well-maintained. After your shift, you may take the truck home.

Can you see yourself driving between these two fixed sites for a reliable client? Apply today and secure a stable, well-paid job with future prospects!

• You have a valid CE driving license

• You are up to date with Code 95 and medical examination

• Experience with tipper transport is a plus, not a must

• You are punctual, reliable, and able to work independently

• You have a strong sense of responsibility

• You speak and understand basic Dutch or English

• You have at least lower secondary education

• 0 to 5 years of experience is sufficient

• Both junior and medior profiles are welcome

As a Pistol Painter, you'll play a crucial role in our vibrant team, ensuring every vehicle part meets our high-quality standards. You'll be responsible for preparing parts, mixing paint, and applying it with precision. Your keen eye for detail will ensure that every vehicle leaves our facility looking its best.

Your day will be hands-on from start to finish. Begin with checking parts for assembly, then move on to sanding, degreasing, and masking. You'll mix paint in our state-of-the-art lab, spray it on truck bodies, and conduct thorough final inspections to ensure perfection.

Ready to bring your painting skills to life in a dynamic work setting? Apply today and contribute to a team that values quality and craftsmanship!

• Eye for detail and color precision
• Experience as a repairer/painter
• Fluent in English
• Strong communication skills and teamwork ability
• Passion for technique and craftsmanship
• Valid driving license B

jobs.description:
Our client in the Netherlands, distributor in equipment, consumables and reagents for life sciences industry and universities, we are looking for a Sales manager (Brussels/Wallonia/ Luxemburg region) for a permanent position.
 

Verantwoordelijkheden
 
 

• After training of the products and equipment, you will be further guided by an experienced manager in the field to introduce the products to new and existing customers in the life science market. 

• You visit new customers and maintain contacts with existing customers.You listen to their needs, give advice and negotiate price proposals 

• You supervise and follow up demos of equipment / kits with customers in collaboration with the specialists. 

• You visit fairs, participate in seminars or webinars. 

• You meet your colleagues (1 day per month) at the office for team meetings, new product launches, administrative tasks, team building, etc 

• You report to the sales and marketing manager 

Vereisten
 
 

• You have a bachelor or master degree in biochemistry, biotechnology or you have relevant experience in a similar sales position. 

• You have a commercial attitude and you are communicative. 

• You have affinity with biotechnology lab equipment, consumables, reagents. 

• You can organize yourself, you are creative and can take initiative. 

• You speak and write fluently French and English and have a good knowledge of Dutch (is a plus).

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Representative Travel Europe | Hoogstraten | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
For our client in Hoogstraten, we are looking for a Customer Service Representative Travel Europe with immediate permanent employment.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the main point of contact for the customers when it comes to orders, production process follow up, deliveries and introduction of new products. Together with the team of colleagues in the Belgian office and worldwide you ensure the highest level of satisfaction and are able to provide a solution to any problem, either commercial or logistical.

Main Responsibilties: 

 
• End-to-end customer service: from order intake to delivery and aftersales follow-up 
 
• Processing and monitoring sales orders (order entry, production follow-up, delivery tracking) 
 
• Handling complaints and finding solutions in close cooperation with sales 
 
• Daily coordination with internal departments and international stakeholders 
 
• Forecasting, demand management and stock monitoring 
 
• Supporting the sales team with commercial and operational tasks 
 
• Ensuring excellent customer satisfaction at all times

Typical day: 
 
• Morning: order entry and administrative processing 
 
• Afternoon: customer follow-up and complaint handling 

 
• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience 
 
• Minimum of 2 years' commercial experience in an international B-to B market environment 
 
• Experience with ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite 
 
• Knowledge of logistics, INCO terms and customs procedures is preferred 
 
• Positive mindset, desire to learn and improve yourself as well as existing processes, attention to detail and problem solving 
 
• Proficient in English and Dutch both oral and written, German or Spanish are an advantage

Your mission
 

We are looking for a dedicated Night Receptionist to ensure smooth and secure overnight operations across our hotels. 
 

If you're detail-oriented, dependable, and enjoy working independently during the quiet hours, this is your chance to make a difference where it matters most. 
 

You will be responsible for overseeing the front desk operations during the overnight shift, ensuring smooth and efficient guest service, and performing end-of-day financial reconciliation. 
 

This role is a combination of guest service, administrative, and accounting duties, requiring attention to detail, accuracy, and professionalism. This role also includes light food & beverage duties, such as preparing and setting up the breakfast service for early morning guests.

Your profile
 

• Previous experience in hotel front office or night audit role preferred 

• Fluency in English and French (Dutch is a plus) 

• Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and financial reconciliation 

• Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS); experience with Opera, Opera Cloud is a plus 

• Excellent communication and customer service skills 

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision 

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
 

Job requirements
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Front Desk Operations 

• Welcome and check-in late arrivals in a professional and friendly manner 

• Handle guest requests, inquiries, and complaints promptly and efficiently 

• Process check-outs and prepare bills for early departing guests 

• Ensure lobby and reception areas are clean and presentable during the night 

• Follow daily night checklist 

Night Audit and Reporting 

• Perform nightly audit of all hotel revenue, including rooms, food & beverage, and other outlets 

• Reconcile and balance daily transactions and post any necessary corrections 

• Prepare daily summary reports for management (e.g. occupancy, revenue, etc.) 

• Roll the date in the property management system (PMS) and close the business day 

Security and Safety 

• Monitor the property to ensure the safety and security of guests and staff 

• Follow emergency procedures and report any suspicious activity to management or security personnel 

• Conduct property walks and ensures all access points are secure 

Cash Handling 

• Reconcile the front desk cash drawer and ensure all transactions are properly accounted for
